facts.fact: The World Bank says 44.4% of the cash transfers under Tunisia's AMEN Program have been digitalized, and a convention between the Ministry of Social Affairs and the Tunisian Post continues digital payment cards tied to an e-wallet for AMEN beneficiaries.

The World Bank says AMEN targeting is being fine-tuned through improvements to the social registry and the introduction of a unique identifier, with interoperability among government agencies improving verification of eligibility criteria.

systems.platform: social registry with proxy-means test and unique identifier
